name: apm-lifecycle-tests
description: Use this skill when you write, extend or migrate an APM lifecycle test: any test that drives the real apm CLI through command sequences and checks durable state (deployed files, lockfile, MCP configs, approvals, egress). Apply it for a bug fix or behavior change in install, update, uninstall, prune, compile, audit, approve or deny, pack or bundle, marketplace, policy, MCP or LSP; for a regression trap; for a lifecycle_smoke test, state-machine rule, replay row, scenario, security table or docs journey; and whenever a reviewer says lifecycle coverage is missing, even if the request only says "add an e2e or integration test". It names the promise, picks the instrument, writes the failing-before test with snapshot and invariant oracles, and records the bug-ledger row. Not for pure unit tests, PR review verdicts, or deciding which tests to delete.
